**Subject: Executive Briefing Proposal for Tamarack Instruments**

Dear Dana Whitfield,

Thank you for the discovery call of 6 October 2026. Tamarack Instruments designs and manufactures laboratory measurement instruments and operates in the Netherlands, Germany and the United States. The Client has deployed a customer service chatbot on its support portal, is piloting AI visual inspection on its German production line and plans AI sales forecasting next year. The stated objective is to have governance in place before visual inspection goes into production in Q2 2027. A June 2026 internal audit finding recorded that there is no inventory of AI systems. ISO/IEC 42001 work is expected to start next year, although the start date is not fixed.

The Executive Briefing is a two-hour live virtual session for executive leadership. For the Client it will cover four areas.

- **Regulation:** Expectations under the EU AI Act and GDPR as they may apply to the chatbot, the inspection pilot and planned forecasting. These are presented as expectations to verify with counsel and are not legal advice. United States requirements appear only as a general landscape item.
- **Readiness:** Readiness at the piloting stage, beginning with what an AI system inventory should contain to address the audit finding.
- **Operating model:** A governance operating model drawing on the GRC Workbook and Slow AI Kitchen, with AI Governance for Boards as the board-layer reference. This includes how the model could align with the Client's ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO 9001 frameworks.
- **Priorities:** Implementation priorities against the Q2 2027 milestone. These respect two constraints: customer data stays in the EU, and the German works council is consulted before anything touches production staff.

Throughout, the session applies three principles: Slow AI, Informed Intent, Final Liability rests with the Human.

The proposed audience is the General Counsel, CISO, Head of Quality, Head of Data, German plant manager and two internal auditors. The fee is US$3,000, within the US$80,000 budget noted as approved for this fiscal year. The session date is Unknown and will be agreed with you.

Afterward the Client receives a written summary recording the decisions surfaced, readiness observations and prioritized recommendations, each mapped to a possible next program option. The Briefing does not promise certification, audit outcomes or regulatory approval. It gives leadership a shared basis for decisions.

As a next step, I propose a short call to confirm attendees and a session date ahead of the decision expected by 15 December 2026.

Kind regards,

Senior AI Governance Consultant
AI Governance Academy
